Problem Statement & Clinical Crisis

The Post-Hospital Discharge Crisis

Discharged patients receive dense, fragmented medical paperwork, creating severe clinical hazards when navigating recovery alone at home.

19-23%
Adverse Medical Events

Nearly 1 in 5 patients suffers a preventable complication within 30 days of leaving hospital care.

50%+
Medication Discrepancies

Over half of post-discharge errors stem from misunderstood dosages, duplicate prescriptions, or omitted drugs.

65%
Linguistic Barriers

Patients receive English papers with Latin abbreviations (q.d., b.i.d., p.r.n.) with zero native translation.

$26B+
Annual Readmission Burden

Unplanned 30-day readmissions impose billions in CMS HRRP financial penalties across hospitals.

Paperwork Fragmentation & Conflict:

A single patient encounter generates disparate documents: Clinical Discharge Summaries, Outpatient Prescriptions, Pathology Sheets, and Referral Letters — frequently with contradictory follow-up dates or modified dosages.

The Fundamental Dilemma:

"The critical medical information already exists in the patient's paperwork, but they cannot safely, clearly, or reliably navigate it after walking out of the hospital doors."

The Solution & Core Innovation

CARELYNX: Grounded Clinical Navigation

A safety-first clinical intelligence platform that ingests unstructured medical records and outputs verified, interactive patient care plans.

📄 100% Verbatim Evidence Grounding

Zero hallucinated clinical data. Every extracted medication, dose, allergy, and follow-up appointment links directly to line-by-line character offset quotes (char_start, char_end) on the exact page of the hospital records. Patients click any fact to view original document proof.

⚠️ Deterministic Conflict Detection

Discharge documents frequently disagree (e.g. Discharge Note says Lisinopril 10mg; Prescription Order says 20mg). CARELYNX automatically cross-checks encounters, identifies discrepancies without guessing, and quarantines them from patient view.

👨‍⚕️ Human-in-the-Loop Clinical Review Queue (/review)

Ambiguous instructions, smudged OCR scans, or clinical conflicts are immediately escalated to a dedicated review workspace for discharge nurses and physicians to inspect side-by-side and resolve with mandatory rationale notes.

🌐 Safe Multilingual Translation & Read Aloud

Supports 6 languages (Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, English). A strict Dosage Preservation Covenant keeps brand drug names, strengths, and numerical frequencies untranslated while translating actionable instructions, backed by Web Speech TTS audio.

End-to-End System Architecture

Production System Architecture

Engineered for air-gapped on-premise hospital clusters or scalable cloud deployments with zero data leaks.

1
Ingest & Validation
Multi-page PDF / image upload. Magic-byte sniffing, SHA-256 integrity, private storage isolation, and Tesseract 5.5 OCR. Computes page text-quality score (gate ≥ 0.85).
2
AMD ROCm vLLM
High-throughput inference with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on ROCm 6.x. Continuous PagedAttention batching with guided JSON schema decoding (`response_format: json_schema`).
3
Safety & Conflicts
Deterministic conflict matrix. Verbatim substring validation. Auto-routes conflicting or low-confidence facts (<0.80) to review_cases with immutable audit logging.
4
Care Plan & FHIR R4
Next.js 16 reactive dashboard. Calendar timeline, medication cards, emergency red-flag warning banners, and standard FHIR R4 MedicationStatement Bundle export.
Full Technology Stack: FastAPI • SQLAlchemy 2.0 • PostgreSQL / SQLite • Alembic • Next.js 16 (Turbopack) • TailwindCSS • Docker Compose • Tesseract 5.5
HIPAA-Compliant Storage Vault

⚡ AMD ROCm & vLLM Acceleration Deep Dive

Powered by AMD ROCm & vLLM

Harnessing AMD Instinct (MI300X/MI250), Radeon, and Ryzen AI for high-throughput, private, local clinical intelligence.

⚡ vLLM PagedAttention on ROCm

Medical discharge records span 5 to 20 pages (4K-16K tokens). ROCm 6.x with vLLM PagedAttention and FlashAttention-2 kernels delivers continuous batching with gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 and max_model_len=8192, slashing Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) by up to 3.8x.

🔒 100% Private On-Premise AI (Zero PHI Egress)

Zero Protected Health Information (PHI) ever leaves hospital infrastructure. Local execution on AMD Instinct hardware eliminates commercial cloud API leaks, compliance liabilities, and unpredictable per-token pricing volatility.

📊 Verified Hardware Provenance & Telemetry

Every extraction records truthful hardware provenance: INFERENCE_HARDWARE_LABEL="amd-rocm-vllm" verified via rocm-smi / amd-smi ASIC detection. Built-in benchmark suite in infra/amd/benchmark_rocm.py.

# Production AMD vLLM Stack (infra/amd/docker-compose.rocm.yml)
services:
  vllm-rocm: image: rocm/vllm:latest | devices: [/dev/kfd, /dev/dri] | shm_size: 16g
  command: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --guided-decoding-backend outlines

Clinical Safety Invariants

Deterministic Safety & Non-Goals

CARELYNX is an information navigation platform, not a doctor. We enforce strict clinical guardrails to eliminate autonomous medical decisions.

🚫 Strict Non-Goals (What CARELYNX Will NEVER Do)
  • × Never Diagnose: Does not interpret lab biomarkers or symptoms as a medical diagnosis.
  • × Never Alter Dosages: Does not modify, substitute, or recalculate drug dosages.
  • × Never Arbitrarily Pick a Winner: Conflicting documents are flagged for human review.
  • × Never Hallucinate: Claims lacking verbatim source quotes are rejected.
  • × Never Replace Clinicians: Provides navigation support; licensed clinicians retain authority.
🛡️ Mathematical Safety Gates & Verification Policy
  • ✓ Application-Level Confidence: Computed in Python code, never by model self-report:
    conf = min(page_quality, ocr_conf, quote_quality) * legibility_factor
  • ✓ Page Quality Gate (≥0.85): Garbage scans trigger immediate review.
  • ✓ Fact Confidence Gate (≥0.80): Borderline facts marked NEEDS_REVIEW.
  • ✓ Deterministic Status Lifecycle: VERIFIED • NEEDS_REVIEW • HUMAN_REQUIRED • CONFLICT_DETECTED • REJECTED.
  • ✓ Zero-Downtime Fallback: Automatic fallback to deterministic rule engine if GPU endpoint is offline.

📊 Clinical Evaluation Benchmark & Scenarios

Rigorous Clinical Evaluation Suite

Audited against synthetic hospital encounters and multi-document edge cases via apps/api/scripts/evaluate_clinical.py.

Scenario A
Clean Discharge

Standard 3-page post-op summary. 100% extraction precision; all medications, follow-ups, and wound care verified.

Scenario B
Degraded OCR Scan

Low-resolution image with artifacts. Text quality drops below 0.85 → System safely abstains, routes to review queue.

Scenario C
Multi-Doc Conflict

Summary says 14 Oct; prescription says 16 Oct. Triggers CONFLICT_DETECTED with HIGH severity. 0% silent errors.

Scenario D
Multilingual Indic

Care plan translated into Hindi & Gujarati. Dosages and drug names strictly preserved via token masking.

Healthcare Equity & Language Access

Multilingual Care Navigation

Empowering non-native speakers across 6 languages with our zero-risk Dosage Preservation Covenant.

Supported Languages

Full UI & Care Plan translation across:

English (en) हिन्दी (Hindi) ગુજરાતી (Gujarati) मराठी (Marathi) தமிழ் (Tamil) తెలుగు (Telugu)

Dosage Preservation Rule

A life-saving safety covenant: Brand drug names, chemical names, units (mg, mL, IU), and numerical frequencies remain untranslated to prevent catastrophic transliteration errors that cause fatal overdoses.

Plain-Language Guidance & Audio

Converts clinical abbreviations and dense directives (e.g. "ambulate with assistance", "NPO post midnight") into warm, culturally appropriate instructions in the patient's native tongue, with interactive Read Aloud speech.

Clinical Safety Example: "Take Metformin 500mg with breakfast" → हिन्दी: "नाश्ते के साथ Metformin 500mg लें" (Dosage preserved bit-for-bit) Zero Medication Risk
